name: Freshbooks
description_en:
Freshbooks is a product in the Accounting category. Its directory profile covers Budget Forecasting, Payroll Management, Tax Management, Spend Management, Revenue Recognition, Purchasing, Project Accounting, Multi-Currency.

Additional listed capabilities include General Ledger, Fixed Asset Management, Expense Tracking, CPA Firms, Collections, Cash Management, Billing and Invoicing, Bank Reconciliation. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business Freelancers. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $6.30. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: prepare payroll records and payment calculations; organize tax-related records and calculations; work with records denominated in multiple currencies; organize accounting entries in a central ledger; record expenses and organize supporting information; track cash positions and related transactions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Freshbooks 属于会计与记账软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括预算预测、薪资管理、税务管理、支出管理、收入确认、采购、项目会计、多币种。

资料还列出总账、固定资产管理、费用跟踪、会计师事务所适用、款项催收、现金管理、账单与开票、银行对账。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为中型企业 小型企业 自由职业者。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $6.30. 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：整理薪资记录并计算工资支付；整理税务相关记录与计算；处理以不同币种计价的记录；在总账中组织会计分录；记录费用并整理相关凭证；跟踪现金状况和相关交易。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
